in_marathi.name: Ajitsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror of the Mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajitsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajit is the name of the god of victory and sinh means lion. Ajitsinh is a powerful name meaning the conqueror of the mind, the brave one, the victorious one and the strong warrior.

in_bengali.name: Ajitsinh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Conqueror of the Mind
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ajitsinh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ajit is the name of the god of victory and sinh means lion. Ajitsinh is a powerful name meaning the conqueror of the mind, the brave one, the victorious one and the strong warrior.
